_comment: Maps governments to the software platform powering their public council/board meeting-agenda portal, for a Flock/ALPR agenda-monitoring crawler (scripts/meeting_watch.py). 'id' is the stable gov identifier (findings live under assets/meetings/<id>/). ingest = discovery layer (json|rss|pdf); keyword match happens on the linked agenda item text / packet PDF. Verified against live endpoints 2026-05-29. Seed set = San Mateo County (SMPD's backyard); expand to SMPD sharing partners next.

platforms.primegov: JSON: https://<client>.primegov.com/api/v2/PublicPortal/ListUpcomingMeetings + ListArchivedMeetings?year=YYYY; agenda text via /Public/CompiledDocument?meetingTemplateId=<templateId>&compileOutputType=3 (HTML Agenda)
platforms.legistar: JSON (Granicus): https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/<client>/events + /events/<id>/eventitems; item-level EventItemTitle/EventItemMatterName searchable via API
platforms.granicus-viewpublisher: RSS: https://<client>.granicus.com/ViewPublisherRSS.php?view_id=N&mode=agendas; agenda body is a linked PDF
platforms.iqm2: RSS (Granicus/MinuteTraq): <client>.iqm2.com/Citizens/...RSS.aspx; docs typed FileOpen.aspx?Type=14 agenda/1 packet/15 minutes; PDF-oriented
platforms.civicplus-agendacenter: RSS: <domain>/rss.aspx + /RSSFeed.aspx?ModID=58&...; agenda body is a linked PDF
platforms.selfhosted-pdf: No feed; agenda PDFs on the CMS -> OCR (reuse scripts/ocr_sidecar.py)

Listing page www.redwoodcity.org WAF-blocks curl/WebFetch → needs Playwright; PDF host serves HTTPS only (http times out). Confirmed: 2026-05-20 item 6b = ALPR RFP feedback (Flock contract expiring, going to RFP).
Also mirrors to CivicPlus AgendaCenter (/rss.aspx) — alt ingest path.

portals._comment_oversight: POLICE OVERSIGHT / ADVISORY bodies — the highest-signal ALPR venues, and (per the Redwood City PAC discovery) usually NOT on the city's main council portal. Only ~4 real ones exist county-wide. Cities NOT listed here have no oversight body → ALPR routes through the full City Council (often as a recurring 'quarterly ALPR report'), or through the County Sheriff (ICAC) for sheriff-contract cities: San Carlos, Woodside, Millbrae, Half Moon Bay, Portola Valley + unincorporated.

portals.notes: POLICE OVERSIGHT body, standing (est. 2021). Meets ~Feb/Jun/Oct. CONFIRMED ALPR: 2025-02-24 'UAS and ALPR Update'. belmont.gov WAFs plain fetch — use the granicus subdomain.

portals.body: Commission on Equity and Public Safety
portals.feed: https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/ci-ssf-ca/events (body 'Commission on Equity and Public Safety') — ALREADY covered by the existing south-san-francisco-ca Legistar adapter
portals.notes: Police oversight body since 2022, 3rd Mon monthly. IS in the Legistar API. DEEP-READ 5/2026: scanned all 18 meetings Jan2025-May2026 at item level → ZERO ALPR. Also published as PDFs on ssfca.gov + eScribe (bm-public-ssf.escribemeetings.com).

portals.body: Independent Civilian Advisory Commission on the Sheriff's Office (ICAC)
portals.feed: https://www.smcgov.org/ceo/independent-civilian-advisory-commission-sheriffs-office (agenda PDFs linked on the page — 2026 on main page, 2024/2025 on -meetings-YYYY sub-pages; site NOT WAF'd, fetchable; also GovDelivery). NOT on the Legistar calendar.
portals.notes: Civilian oversight of the Sheriff (est. Dec 2023, 1st Wed monthly). Sheriff runs ALPR for the contract cities + unincorporated, so ICAC is THEIR oversight venue. DEEP-READ 5/2026: scanned all 17 agendas 2025-2026 → ZERO ALPR (focus = Inspector General/subpoena power + sheriff succession; one generic 'cameras and drones' jail/patrol tech line, not ALPR).

portals._comment_quasi: Lower-signal / not true oversight: Half Moon Bay & Millbrae have 2-member Council 'Public Safety Subcommittees' (as-needed, sparse agendas; both sheriff-contract); Pacifica 'Emergency Preparedness & Safety Commission' (disaster-focused, self-hosted PDFs, not on its iqm2 portal); San Bruno 'Crime Prevention Committee' (outreach, AgendaCenter); East Palo Alto 'Measure C Oversight Committee' (fiscal watchdog of police funding only). EPA's Flock decisions happen at full Council (12/3/2025 approved 3-yr renewal 3-2; 4/8/2026 declined to revisit).
